WOODWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

2. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.

3. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.

4. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.

5. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

7. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.

8. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

10. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.

11. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

12. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

13. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.

14. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Occupational Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
